title: Hungry Goats
subject: Imibare
topic: Objective: Counting, reading, and matching abstract digits with concrete quantities.
outcomes: A target number (1-9) appears in a speech bubble above a goat. Students use Tap-to-Feed to move bananas from a basket to a plate. Tapping a banana increments the plate counter. Tap ✅ to check or ↩️ to reset.

title: RWF Coin Matcher
subject: Imibare
topic: Objective: Identifying Rwandan coin denominations and matching their numerical values with English words.
unit: P1 U9 / P2 U8: Rwandan Currency.
outcomes: A two-column matching game. The left column displays 4 random Rwandan coins rendered in metallic gradients. The right column displays shuffled English text values (e.g., "Fifty Francs"). Students use Tap-to-Match to connect pairs

title: Shape Detective
subject: Imibare
topic: Objective: Recognizing and distinguishing squares, rectangles, triangles, and circles.
unit: P1 U11 / P2 U11: Geometry & Shapes.
outcomes: A dynamic instruction states the target shape (e.g., "Find all Triangles!"). A grid filled with multicolored shapes appears below. Students act as detectives to speed-tap all matching shapes before the timer ends.

title: Banana Fractions
subject: Imibare
topic: Objective: Visualizing parts of a whole, shading, and understanding denominators.
outcomes: The screen displays a fractional prompt (e.g., "Shade 3/4"). In the center, a circle is dynamically divided into sectors matching the denominator. Students tap sectors to toggle yellow shading. Tap ✅ to verify the fraction.

title: The Pattern Bridge
subject: Imibare
topic: Objective: Identifying common differences in ascending or descending arithmetic sequences.
unit: P1 U7 / P3 U13: Number Patterns.
outcomes: A zebra wants to cross a river. A bridge of 5 stepping stones forms a number sequence (e.g., 2, 4, ?, 8, 10) with one missing link marked as "?". Students tap the correct leaf button from 3 multiple-choice options to complete the bridge.
